x: 2 Mile Walk—1, Beecham (340); 2, Shields (540); 3, True (560); Time, 14 min. 1.6 secs. Long Jump—1, Ansell (3ft.); 2, J. Smith (3ft. 6in.); 3, Edmunds (4ft.); Dist., 21ft. 7ins.
Jones and Ansell score a good win in their heat to qualify for the final. In this the Poly. lads were the winners in the good time of 43.9 secs., which was much too fast for our boys.
